common.notFoundBody: It may have been deleted. Pick it again from your labs.
common.disclaimer: This analysis is made by AI for general awareness; it is not a diagnosis or treatment. The final interpretation is your doctor's.

intro.title: Lab analysis
intro.heroBody: Upload a photo or PDF of your lab sheet; the values are read, compared with the reference ranges and explained in plain words.
intro.emptyBody: Upload your first lab sheet; results stay here so you can follow their trend.

upload.title: Upload a lab
upload.pageCount: {count, plural, =0 {No pages} one {# page} other {# pages}}
upload.limitsHint: Up to {max} pages; JPEG, PNG or WebP photos or a PDF.

tips.columns: All columns visible, including the reference range
tips.privacy: Better to cover your name and national ID on the sheet

upload.plusNote: AI lab analysis is part of Ritme Plus.

errors.file_type: Only photos (JPEG, PNG, WebP) or PDF files are accepted.
errors.image_too_large: Each photo can be up to {image} MB.
errors.pdf_too_large: A PDF can be up to {pdf} MB.
errors.too_many_files: You can send up to {max} pages.
errors.files_required: Add at least one page of your lab sheet.
errors.upload_too_large: The files are too large together; remove a page or two.
errors.date_future: The lab date can't be after today.
errors.consent: To continue, read and accept the consent first.
errors.network: No connection. Check your internet and try again.
errors.busy: Analysis isn't available right now; try again a little later.

processing.title: Just a few seconds
processing.leaveNote: You can leave this page; this lab's status shows under «Previous analyses».
processing.slow: This is taking longer than usual.
processing.failedBody: The sheet couldn't be analyzed; upload it again.

verify.title: Check the values
verify.heading: Were these numbers read correctly?
verify.lead: Before the analysis, compare the values read with your sheet.
verify.lowConfidence: {count, plural, one {# value was read with low confidence} other {# values were read with low confidence}}
verify.empty: No values were read; add the markers by hand.
verify.limit: This lab has reached its analysis limit.
verify.rangeHint: Enter the reference range as printed on the sheet; leave it empty if there is none.

errors.name: Enter the marker name.
errors.order: The low bound must be below the high bound.

result.title: Analysis result
result.subtitle: {title} · {date}
result.attentionTitle: {count, plural, one {# needs attention} other {# need attention}}
result.stale: Values changed; the explanation is being prepared again.
result.questions: Questions you can ask your doctor
result.askSub: Chat with the health assistant about this result
result.deleteConfirm: Delete this lab, its values and files for good?
